steps.what: Retrieve the actual engineering sketch, specification or drawing revision and its referenced mechanical details in engineering document control (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual drawing/specification identifier and interpretation question
actual controlled drawing revisions and existing references
outputs: technician-selected current source drawing and relevant referenced details

steps.what: Interpret engineering sketches, specifications or drawings, including mechanical relationships, dimensions, tolerances and unresolved ambiguities
inputs: technician-selected current source drawing and relevant referenced details
actual interpretation question and equipment context
outputs: technician's interpretation and unresolved mechanical drawing questions

tasks.design: Configure native revision and cross-reference navigation in {OPS_SYSTEM}, engineering document control and the mechanical drawing viewer. The technician still reads the actual drawing and decides its mechanical meaning; no model supplies missing dimensions or resolves ambiguous tolerances.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct revision and referenced detail can interrupt interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing references and controlled revision views can reduce repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Geometry, tolerances and intended equipment behavior require mechanical understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when a plausible interpretation conflicts with the physical assembly.

ambition.what: Reduce actual source navigation around interpretation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native controlled-drawing references can reduce retrieval effort while mechanical interpretation remains specialist work.

assumptions: Engineering document control supplies actual drawings, revisions and existing references; source selection and missing-link handling remain in s1. No newly tagged drawing set is assumed.
Native configuration first; already-linked views remove the gain. Missing revisions or unclear references require manual retrieval, not inferred drawing content.
The statement is interpretation, not an additional report or send. Lookup is explicitly separated; no required record write is hidden in live discussion.
Shares 20/80 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 6 minus 1 hour of link/view upkeep gives 5 net.
unknowns: Actual existing revision and cross-reference navigation
research_questions: Measure retrieval separately from actual mechanical interpretation.

already_counted.description: Source verification and actual drawing interpretation remain.

incremental.description: Maintain native reference views and check broken links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured E1 range below provisional 5 percent net; interpretation remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Size equipment and submit calculations for engineering approval

steps.what: Capture and reconcile actual system duty, specified performance, equipment data and units for the proposed system
inputs: actual specified performance and system configuration
actual equipment data supplied by equipment/design owners
outputs: technician-checked sizing inputs with sources, units and missing-data notes

steps.what: Select and verify the applicable equipment-capacity equations, margins, boundary conditions and worksheet input mapping
inputs: technician-checked sizing inputs with sources, units and missing-data notes
actual engineering-approved sizing methods for the equipment family
outputs: technician-selected checked calculation method and mapped sizing inputs

steps.what: Calculate required capacities for equipment of the proposed system using the selected checked parametric sizing worksheet and flag missing or out-of-domain inputs
inputs: technician-selected checked calculation method and mapped sizing inputs
outputs: calculated equipment capacities with equation/input provenance and flagged limits

steps.what: Populate the engineering submission data sheet with the exact calculated capacities, original inputs, methods and unresolved limits
inputs: calculated equipment capacities with equation/input provenance and flagged limits
technician-checked sizing inputs with sources, units and missing-data notes

steps.what: Check the complete capacities, formulas, units, source data, limitations and exact submission version and engineering recipient
inputs: proposed equipment-capacity submission data sheet
technician-selected checked calculation method and mapped sizing inputs
actual engineering recipient and submission requirements
outputs: exact checked capacity submission version and internal engineering recipient

steps.what: Submit the exact checked capacity data to engineering personnel for their actual engineering approval
inputs: exact checked capacity submission version and internal engineering recipient
outputs: capacity data submitted to actual engineering personnel, pending their decision

tasks.design: Configure a reusable parametric sizing worksheet in {SPREADSHEET} and a linked capacity-data sheet in {DOCS}. The technician captures actual inputs, selects the valid engineering method and checks the complete calculated submission before separately sending it to engineering personnel; their engineering approval follows receipt and is not inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring equipment families can require repeated sizing-sheet setup and transcription into an approval data sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Checked native formulas and linked document fields can reuse explicit calculations and sources.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, duty conditions, margins and input quality remain engineering questions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that a numerically correct capacity is unsuitable for the actual proposed system.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated calculation setup and submission transcription.

reach.task: Review the received capacity data and make the actual approval decision

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with the responsible engineer and worksheet owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checked parametric sizing worksheets and linked submission fields can replace repeated calculation setup/transcription; input validation and engineering approval remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: This is recurring sizing within an actual equipment family with an engineering-approved method. Actual design/equipment owners supply duty and equipment data; the technician captures and reconciles them in s1 and maps/checks method applicability in s2.
Missing inputs, incompatible units or out-of-domain conditions stop for manual engineering. No model invents loads, equations, equipment ratings or margins.

Native worksheet/formulas and linked fields first. Existing equivalent calculators or data-sheet links remove the corresponding saving; arithmetic runtime already available today earns no gain. s3's saving represents replaced repeated worksheet construction/calculation handling, not computer runtime.

Shares 20/15/25/15/24/1 are unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 40 minus 4 hours of method/template upkeep leaves 36 net. Actual input capture, applicability selection and full final checking remain.

The one-unit internal send is negligible and fully retained. s5 checks the final version and recipient; edits invalidate that gate. Engineering approval occurs after s6 and is not counted as a technician saving or falsely recorded as obtained.
unknowns: Actual repeatability of equipment sizing and existing worksheet links
research_questions: Measure repeated worksheet construction and data-sheet transcription separately from input/method verification.

already_counted.description: Actual inputs, method selection and full final submission checking remain.

incremental.description: Maintain and verify engineering sizing methods and linked data-sheet fields.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked capacity submission version and internal engineering recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 36 percent net, conditional on actual repeated sizing-sheet setup and transcription.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Ascertain test requirements and investigate technical problems

steps.what: Retrieve current project instructions and blueprints and their referenced test requirements in engineering document control (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual project instructions, blueprints and test question

steps.what: Review project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures and objectives; check the final diagnostic test method and actual equipment readiness
inputs: technician-selected actual project/test source set
actual authorized test equipment and current physical conditions
outputs: exact checked diagnostic test method, objectives, configuration and readiness

steps.what: Test the nature of actual technical problems such as redesign using the checked diagnostic method and configuration
inputs: exact checked diagnostic test method, objectives, configuration and readiness
actual machinery and measurement equipment
outputs: technician's actual diagnostic test observations and unresolved technical problems

steps.what: Record actual diagnostic observations and test identifiers, interpret limits and check the complete existing diagnostic record and destination
inputs: technician's actual diagnostic test observations and unresolved technical problems
actual project and test identifiers
outputs: exact checked diagnostic record, limits and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked diagnostic record in its intended internal project/test revision
inputs: exact checked diagnostic record, limits and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native project/test reference views and retained test identifiers in {OPS_SYSTEM}, engineering document and test-record software. The technician interprets the actual instructions, checks readiness, performs the diagnostic work and records/checks real observations before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated reference navigation and test context entry surround actual diagnostic work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project/test record links can retain actual context.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the problem and selecting a valid diagnostic approach require mechanical judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the observed problem differs from the blueprint assumption.

ambition.what: Reduce context handling around actual diagnostic tests.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked engineering references and test-record context can reduce navigation/entry while test interpretation and physical diagnostics remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual documented diagnostic episode within existing test authority. No new formal test report or external release is added.
Project owners supply actual instructions/blueprints; the technician selects them in s1, verifies method/readiness in s2, produces observations in s3 and captures/checks them in s4.
Reuse only existing source links and actual project/test identifiers. Missing requirements or measurements require manual resolution; there is no free sensor feed or inferred result.

Shares 10/40/35/14/1 are unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 2 + 1.4 = 3.4; 1 hour of context upkeep leaves 2.4 net. Existing equivalent configuration removes the gain; negligible save is fully retained.
Changed diagnostic method/configuration returns to s2 before execution. Record edits return to s4 before save; no separate self-approval ceremony is introduced.
unknowns: Actual diagnostic record and current linked reference views
research_questions: Observe actual lookup and test-identifier entry separately from diagnosis.

already_counted.description: Source checks, method/readiness, physical diagnostics and final observation recording remain.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked diagnostic test method, objectives, configuration and readiness
exact checked diagnostic record, limits and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 2.4 percent net; substantive diagnostics remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the actual employee's mechanical design, fabrication, testing or documentation problem and inspect the relevant evidence
inputs: actual employee question and equipment/drawing/test context
outputs: technician-understood actual support problem and missing evidence

steps.what: Retrieve actual linked mechanical drawings, fabrication instructions, test procedures or controlled documentation relevant to the question
inputs: technician-understood actual support problem and missing evidence
actual controlled engineering records and existing references

steps.what: Provide technical support to other employees regarding mechanical design, fabrication, testing or documentation through actual diagnosis and explanation
inputs: technician-understood actual support problem and missing evidence
technician-checked actual support source set
actual employee responses
outputs: actual support explanation, agreed limits and unresolved issues

steps.what: Capture the actual support result in the existing help record, reconcile context and check the complete record and destination
inputs: actual support explanation, agreed limits and unresolved issues
actual existing support ticket and equipment/project identifiers
outputs: exact checked mechanical support record and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked mechanical support record in its intended internal ticket revision
inputs: exact checked mechanical support record and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native controlled-document links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and retained ticket/equipment context in {HELPDESK}. The technician diagnoses and explains the actual mechanical issue, then captures/checks the real support outcome before saving; no model controls equipment or sends advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated engineering-record searches and support-ticket context entry surround actual technical assistance.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and existing-ticket defaults can retain actual context.
tasks.still_hard: The employee's problem may need hands-on investigation or engineering escalation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the actual mechanical reasoning and recognize the limits of available evidence.

ambition.what: Reduce record handling in an actual ticketed support episode.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with the engineering support and document owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native engineering-document links and ticket context can reduce support handling while mechanical diagnosis and explanation remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual ticketed support episode. No ticket or written follow-up is invented for every informal conversation.

The employee supplies the real question; document control supplies actual sources. The technician clarifies in s1, checks sources in s2, produces the explanation in s3 and captures/checks the result in s4.
Reuse existing links and identifiers only. Missing records or unknown outcomes remain unresolved, not generated; if native configuration already exists, the gain disappears.
Shares 25/25/35/14/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 7.5 + 2.8 = 10.3 minus 1.5 hours of link/default upkeep leaves 8.8 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
The final record check is part of ordinary capture. Changes invalidate the gate. No hidden notification or field equipment action is proposed.
unknowns: Actual ticket use and repeated support record fields
research_questions: Measure controlled-source lookup and ticket capture separately from actual support.

already_counted.description: Clarification, source checks, diagnosis/explanation and final record capture remain.

incremental.description: Maintain native support references and context defaults.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked mechanical support record and internal destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 8.8 percent net, conditional on actual ticketed support and repeated source handling.
